newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Financial trades on Nasdaq bulletin board.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Financial trades on Nasdaq bulletin board.

text.p: Advanced Financial Inc said Monday it will resume trading on the NASDAQ electronic bulletin board effective immediately.
The company was previously listed on the American Stock Exchange under the symbol AVF.
Advanced Financial said its negotiations with several companies for potential acquisitions that would increase the company's net worth and operating revenues are continuing on an active basis.
Advanced Financial is a holding company with its principal operations conducted through its wholly owned AFI Mortgage Corp subsidiary.
